description: Interview is rescheduled; Heim must follow the new date, not the old one.

key.event: interview first set for Oct 8, rescheduled (told Oct 3) to Oct 15; reported Oct 15: went okay; result expected by Oct 25
key.recurring_worry: feeling unappreciated at her current job, 4 conversations
key.watch_P6: On Oct 8 (old date) Heim must NOT ask how the interview went; it should ask on or after Oct 15

messages: Hi, I'm Divya. I work as a junior ML engineer at a startup in Gurgaon.
Nobody noticed that I fixed the data pipeline over the weekend.
Okay, that's all for now.
I presented my model results in the team meeting and the lead only said 'thanks'.
I feel invisible sometimes.
Good night.
I made pasta from scratch this weekend.
I'm also learning to play the ukulele, slowly.
Talk soon.
A colleague got credit for an idea that was mine.
I don't think anyone here really values what I do.
Bye for now.
Went for a long walk and called my mother.
It was a calm day.
That's all.
I've started looking at other companies, just casually.
I updated my résumé tonight.
Good night.
A company called Brightlane invited me for an interview on October 8.
It's for a machine learning role, a step up from my current one.
I'll prepare over the next week.
Okay, bye.
The recruiter emailed that the interview is moved to October 15.
So I have a bit more time to prepare, which is good.
My boss again didn't acknowledge my work this week.
Talk soon.
I did a mock interview with a friend today.
I need to practise explaining my projects more clearly.
Goodnight.
Practised system design questions all afternoon.
Played the ukulele for a while to relax.
See you.
The Brightlane interview is done.
It went okay, I answered most questions but stumbled on one design question.
They said I'd hear back by October 25.
Waiting for the result is making me restless.
At work nobody said a word about my latest release again.
Anyway, going to cook dinner.

probes.question: When was my interview, and has the date changed?
probes.expected: It was moved from October 8 to October 15 and took place on October 15.

probes.question: Has anything about me changed since we first started talking?
probes.expected: Should mention she started job hunting / had an interview at Brightlane; no other big change.

probes.question: Is my feeling of being unappreciated at work a recurring worry or a one-off? Answer RECURRING or ONE-OFF, and state your confidence as HIGH, MEDIUM or LOW.
How did my interview go, and when will I hear back?
probes.expected: It went okay (stumbled on one design question); she expects to hear back by October 25.
